# agents-heart

> Provider-neutral Python control library (`v0.2.0`) for worker role contract authorization, assignment start/end correlation, and fail-closed worker profile deletion.

## Key Facts
- **Package:** `agents-heart` (`src/agents_heart/__init__.py`, PEP 561 `py.typed`)
- **Python:** `>=3.11` (CI verified on 3.11, 3.12, 3.13 across Linux, Windows, macOS)
- **Runtime Dependencies:** None (pure Python standard library)
- **Network Access:** None (`boundaries.network: "none"`)
- **License:** MIT ([LICENSE](LICENSE))
- **Languages:** English ([README.md](README.md)), German ([README_de.md](README_de.md))

## Core Interfaces
- `authorize_role(role_id: str, mode: str) -> RoleContract`: Fail-closed role & execution mode check (`safe` / `full`). Raises `AssignmentDenied`.
- `begin_assignment(..., event_recorder) -> Assignment`: Emits `assignment.started` receipt with immutable `Assignment` ID and UTC timestamp.
- `finish_assignment(assignment, status, event_recorder, result="", reason="") -> None`: Emits `assignment.ended` receipt for terminal status (`completed`, `released`, `error`, `interrupted`).
- `delete_worker_profile(profile_id, profile, *, assert_inactive, terminal_records, archive, remove) -> bool`: Enforces inactivity and `phase == "terminal"` archive verification before deletion. Raises `ProfileDeletionRejected`.
- `archive_then_remove_profile`: Alias of `delete_worker_profile`.
